hook: orphan 怒氣團擠在服務台：disgruntled／exasperate／fractious／glower——號碼牌寫「先消氣再辦理」。
script: disgruntled 不滿。exasperate 激怒。fractious 躁。glower 怒視。furor 狂怒。gripe 抱怨。crabbed 乖戾。口令：服務台寫「消氣」，怒視寫「先排隊」。

members.senseAnchor: put into a bad mood or into bad humour; in a state of sulky dissatisfaction
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 抱怨單: disgruntled walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「抱怨單」出場：disgruntled 一上場梗就黏住——不滿的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 火上油: exasperate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「火上油」出場：exasperate 一上場梗就黏住——激怒。

members.senseAnchor: stubbornly resistant to authority or control; easily irritated or annoyed
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 躁動椅: fractious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「躁動椅」出場：fractious 一上場梗就黏住——易怒的。

related.synonyms: refractory, recalcitrant, cranky, irritable, nettlesome, peevish

members.senseAnchor: an angry stare; look at with a fixed gaze
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 怒視線: glower walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「怒視線」出場：glower 一上場梗就黏住——怒視。

members.senseAnchor: an interest followed with exaggerated zeal; a sudden outburst (as of protest)
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 暴走潮: furor walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「暴走潮」出場：furor 一上場梗就黏住——狂熱憤怒。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 碎念麥: gripe walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「碎念麥」出場：gripe 一上場梗就黏住——抱怨。

related.synonyms: kick, beef, bitch, squawk, grouse, crab

members.senseAnchor: direct (an aircraft) into a crosswind; scurry sideways like a crab
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 酸臉: crabbed walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「酸臉」出場：crabbed 一上場梗就黏住——乖戾的。

related.synonyms: crab, gripe, bitch, grouse, beef, squawk

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 紅耳: irate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「紅耳」出場：irate 一上場梗就黏住——憤怒的。

members.senseAnchor: angry because you feel unfairly treated
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 正氣怒: indignant walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「正氣怒」出場：indignant 一上場梗就黏住——憤慨的。

members.senseAnchor: be noisy with activity; be in an agitated emotional state
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 沸騰壺: seethe walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「沸騰壺」出場：seethe 一上場梗就黏住——怒火中燒。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 地板滾: tantrum walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「地板滾」出場：tantrum 一上場梗就黏住——發脾氣。
